title: Fletcher Henderson as a quiet leader
summary: Henderson was a milquetoast leader whose men were habitually late and he said nothing.

blocks.x: What about Fletcher? We didn't mention too much
Fletcher was a very quiet guy. He was another milquetoast guy, type of guy. You know, the guys used to just run over him, --
-- the guys in his band. You know, whenever they thought they'd be late, they was always late, you know, and Fletcher didn't have nothing to say, you know.
